privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft — pending legal review under UAE data-protection law before launch.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you place an order or request catering we collect your name, mobile number and email address, and the details of your order or event (date, time, number of guests, location and notes).
We do not collect or store card details. Payments are handled on our payment provider's secure page.

sections.heading: Why we use it
body: To prepare and deliver your order, to review and confirm catering requests, to contact you about them, and to send you confirmations and payment receipts.
We keep a record of your orders and requests so we can help you if you contact us and to meet our accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Confirmation emails and news are separate
body: Confirmation and payment emails are part of handling your order. We send news or offers only if you tick the box asking for them, and you can unsubscribe at any time.

sections.heading: Who can see it
body: Only Umodai staff who handle orders, and the service providers we use to run the website, payments and email, under contracts that protect your data. We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Our retention period will be confirmed before launch.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your details, or withdraw your consent to news and offers, by contacting us using the details on our Visit us page.
